fields.source_row:
[questKeys.name] = "The Talisman of Kazdor",
            [questKeys.questLevel] = 50,
            [questKeys.objectivesText] = {"Find The Talisman of Kazdor inside of Zul'Farrak. Then, bring it to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor. You must complete the job alone."},
            [questKeys.startedBy_add] = {{6707}},
        },

record.description:
From the most recent letter we intercepted, it appears the final artifact Caius desires is the Talisman of Kazdor. The letter states this talisman is somewhere inside Zul'Farrak. 

I want you to complete the job as per Caius' instructions, as not to arouse his suspicion. This means you'll have to go into Zul'Farrak alone, as usual.  

However, before you deliver the Talisman, bring it back here. We'll be giving Caius a little more than he asked for.
record.objectivesText: Find The Talisman of Kazdor inside of Zul'Farrak. Then, bring it to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor. You must complete the job alone.
record.title: The Talisman of Kazdor

[questKeys.name] = "Fool Me Twice",
            [questKeys.questLevel] = 50,
            [questKeys.objectivesText] = {"Speak to Fahrad when you're ready to hear his plan."},
            [questKeys.startedBy_add] = {{6707}},
            [questKeys.finishedBy_add] = {{6707}},
        },

record.description:
Not a moment too soon, $n
 
The manor has been keeping tabs on this "C" character you've been dealing with. 
 
C's true identity is Caius Blackwood; a powerful magic user working with the Syndicate. Our sources say he has been gathering artifacts for an unknown purpose. Only recently did we discover *you* were the one providing them.
 
Caius must be stopped, and I believe the onus of doing so falls on you. Fortunately, I've devised a plan. Come speak to me when you're ready to clear your name.
record.objectivesText: Speak to Fahrad when you're ready to hear his plan.
record.title: Fool Me Twice

fields.source_row:
[questKeys.name] = "Deadliest Catch",
            [questKeys.questLevel] = 56,
            [questKeys.objectivesText] = {"Bring a Mammoth Shark Steak to Berdun Cliffbrew at Talrendis Point in Azshara."},
            [questKeys.startedBy_add] = {{240482}},
            [questKeys.requiredRaces] = 4294967373,
        },

record.description:
If ye fancy yourself a real angler, there's bigger fish out here than ye can catch with a rod.

Mammoth Sharks lurk in the deepest waters of the northern an' southern coasts. They swim far out, right before the sea floor drops away into the great ocean.

They're mighty big; I'd advise ye take a group of anglers with ye. 

Dwarf like me? I prefer dry land. Those sharks'd swallow me in one bite.

If ye do go hunting one, bring me a cut o' the meat. I'd be mighty thankful.
record.objectivesText: Bring a Mammoth Shark Steak to Berdun Cliffbrew at Talrendis Point in Azshara.
record.title: Deadliest Catch

record.description: Well met, $c.  I've something that might interest you.$B$BI have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality.  I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor.$B$BThe blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment.
